messages.subject: Winter 2013 Meetings: 3-5PM in Wickson 2124
parts:
Happy New Year Davis R Users!  The votes are tallied, and the chosen meeting time for this quarter is Wednesdays 3-5 PM. (Final voting results below)  Our first meeting will be on Wednesday, January 9.  We will be meeting in Wickson 2124.

In other exciting news, our sponsorship funds arrived from Revolution Analytics, so there will be snacks!

I will be giving a brief presentation at our first session on best practices for sharing code and collaboration.  We need presenters for future weeks.  Please let me know if you are interested.

Cheers,

Noam
